paragraphs: Posted by Mia. Date: Thursday, October fifteenth. Hi, I am Mia, and this is my typical Thursday. Lily asked me to write about it for Explorers' Blog. Teacher Kim has already read my post. She says, "Your photo of Snow is lovely." Snow is my white kitten.

I get up early, at six o'clock. First, I feed Snow, and then I have breakfast. Snow drinks her milk very fast, and then she sleeps. I put my books in my bag. At half past seven, Lily and I walk to school. It takes ten minutes to walk there. School starts at eight o'clock. In the morning, we study math and English. We have a break at ten o'clock.

At twelve o'clock, we have lunch at school. The club hour starts after lunch, in the school library. The library is quiet, and I like it. Teacher Kim gives each child a book about birds. Today, we read about birds, and then we draw them. Leo draws a funny bird, and May writes a short story. The hour finishes at half past two. Then we have art, and school ends at three o'clock.

I am home at four o'clock. My bag is heavy on Thursday because I carry many books. I do my homework at the kitchen table. I have not finished it yet, because math is hard. I am a little worried about the English test tomorrow. My mom comes home at five o'clock, and we talk about the day. Later, I play with Snow in the garden. We have dinner at six o'clock, and I go to bed at nine o'clock.
That is my typical Thursday. I like Thursday because of the club. What do you do on a typical day? What time do you get up? Write to me soon! Mia
